name: gen-eve-plugin
description: Generate CircuitPython EVE/BT817 demo applications for the IDM2040 board.

interface.shortDescription: Create IDM2040 EVE demo apps and supporting assets.
interface.longDescription: A local Codex plugin for generating and maintaining CircuitPython applications for the IDM2040 board, Bridgetek EVE displays, BT817 graphics, touch UI flows, media playback, and board peripheral demos.
defaultPrompt: Generate an IDM2040 EVE demo app.
Add a BT817 touch UI screen.
Create an EVE media playback demo.
